findings: Six distinct people, seven account records and fifteen individual video URLs; handle aliases do not add people.
All six have a dated released publication within 2025-10-22 through 2026-10-22. Brad's evidence is an interview; Lyssa's date is month precision.
The YouTube sample is a curated index, not a complete catalogue. Only one exact video upload date was exposed; unknown timestamps are null.
Catalogue/title entity labels document practitioners' or publishers' attributions; they do not verify extraterrestrial origin.
